timeline: You probably assume the Darvaza gas crater died out decades ago, but this 230-foot pit has burned non-stop since 1971.
Soviet geologists drilled into a hidden underground cavern here.
The roof collapsed instantly under their heavy drilling equipment.
Poisonous gas began leaking out, endangering nearby villagers.
Engineers decided to set the escaping gas on fire.
They expected the fire to burn out in just a few days.
Instead, the underground gas reserves fed the roaring inferno endlessly.
Today, explorers have even descended into the blistering heat.
Authorities tried capping wells to quiet the eternal flames.
Yet the Door to Hell keeps burning right back into your screen.
